[USER] User has never tried acupuncture before and asked for tips on what to expect during a session.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The acupuncturist will ask about medical history, symptoms, and concerns, and may examine the tongue and pulse.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User will lie down on a comfortable table, and the acupuncturist will insert thin, sterile needles into specific points on the body.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User may feel a slight sensation like a pinch or a dull ache when needles are inserted, but it should not be painful.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User will be left alone to relax with the needles in for about 20 to 40 minutes, during which they may feel calmness and relaxation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] After the session, the acupuncturist will remove the needles and may offer herbal remedies or self-care advice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is crucial to communicate openly with the acupuncturist and inform them of any discomfort.
